hostname ix-s01
!
ip access-list acl-s-nat permit ip src 198.51.100.0/24 dest any
ip prefix-list pl-s-in 10 permit 0.0.0.0/0
!
ip route default 203.0.113.50
!
ip router ospf 1
  router-id 192.0.2.201
  area 1 stub
  redistribute static
  passive-interface GigaEthernet1.0
  network GigaEthernet0.0 area 0
  network GigaEthernet1.0 area 1
  network Loopback0.0 area 0
!
router bgp 64500
  router-id 192.0.2.201
  neighbor 203.0.113.50 remote-as 64501
  neighbor 203.0.113.50 description sample-upstream
  neighbor 203.0.113.50 password dummy-bgp-key-s
  address-family ipv4 unicast
    network 198.51.100.0/24
    neighbor 203.0.113.50 distribute-list pl-s-in in
!
watch-group wg1 10
  event 10 ip unreach-host 203.0.113.50 source GigaEthernet0.0
  probe-timer variance 5
  action 10 ip shutdown-route 0.0.0.0/0 203.0.113.50
!
network-monitor wg1 enable
!
vrrp enable
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  description sample wan
  ip address 203.0.113.49/30
  ip ospf network point-to-point
  ip ospf hello-interval 5
  ip ospf dead-interval 20
  ip napt enable
  ip napt inside list acl-s-nat
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0
  description sample lan
  ip address 198.51.100.2/24
  vrrp 1 ip 198.51.100.1
  vrrp 1 priority 110
  no shutdown
!
interface Loopback0.0
  description sample id
  ip address 192.0.2.201/32
!
